name: Robin Brooks
zh_summary: Can the Fed get away with not hiking later this month? Only with a hawkish press conference, but even that will be tricky. Markets price 8 bps in hikes for October, so not hiking will be a dovish surprise no matter what is said.
en_summary: Can the Fed get away with not hiking later this month? Only with a hawkish press conference, but even that will be tricky. Markets price 8 bps in hikes for October, so not hiking will be a dovish surprise no matter what is said.
text:
Can the Fed get away with not hiking later this month? Only way it can do that is with a hawkish press con, but even that'll be tricky. Markets price 8 bps in hikes for the October meeting, so not hiking will be a dovish surprise no matter what is said...
https://robinjbrooks.substack.com/p/how-will-markets-trade-the-fed
